drug_class: Tyrosine kinase inhibitor (antifibrotic and antineoplastic agent)
purpose: Nintedanib is used to slow down scarring in the lungs caused by conditions like idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF), a disease where the lungs gradually become stiff and scarred. It is also used for certain other chronic lung diseases that cause worsening scarring, as well as a type of lung cancer called non-small cell lung cancer when used with chemotherapy. Essentially, it helps slow down the progression of these serious conditions.
how_it_works: Your lungs can sometimes develop scar tissue due to abnormal cell signaling that tells the body to keep making fibrous (tough) tissue where it should not. Nintedanib works by blocking certain proteins called tyrosine kinases that act like 'on switches' for this harmful process. By turning off these switches, the medication slows down the scarring and abnormal cell growth in your lungs.
common_side_effects: The most common side effect is diarrhea, which can sometimes be severe, so staying hydrated is very important. You may also notice nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, or a decreased appetite. Some people experience elevated liver enzymes (your doctor will monitor this with blood tests), weight loss, and headaches.
warnings: Tell your doctor right away if you notice yellowing of your skin or eyes, dark urine, or severe stomach pain, as these could be signs of liver problems. Nintedanib can increase the risk of bleeding, so let your doctor know if you are on blood thinners or notice unusual bleeding. This medication should NOT be taken during pregnancy as it can harm the unborn baby — use reliable birth control. It may also increase the risk of heart attack, so report any chest pain immediately. Avoid this medication if you are allergic to peanuts or soy, as the capsules contain soy lecithin.
typical_dosing: The usual dose for adults is 150 mg taken by mouth twice a day, about 12 hours apart, with food. Swallow the capsules whole — do not crush or chew them. If you experience bothersome side effects like diarrhea, your doctor may temporarily lower your dose to 100 mg twice daily. Always take it exactly as your doctor prescribes and do not stop without talking to them first.
